body:
# PlayzBetter
- A project to improve Minecraft's QOL features without being too OP.
- _Click on a category in the description to expand it._



<details>
<summary>Instructions</summary>

- Texture Packs go in here as a .zip: %appdata%/.minecraft/resourcepacks
- Data Packs go in here as a .zip: %appdata%/.minecraft/saves/(yourworldhere)/datapacks
- To install the modpack, install through **_Modrinth_** and move any data packs to the above location.

</details>



<details>
<summary>What We Offer</summary>

- Extra features compared to **_Simply Optimized_** and **_OptiFabric_**
- Frequent updates and quality checking
- A modpack made out of trusted mods by popular authors, exclusively on _**Modrinth**_ for a seamless experience
- Compatablility with mods such as _**Biomes O' Plenty**_, **_Essential Mod_**, and **_Cherished Worlds_**
- Being able to use your own shaders and texture packs
</details>
